title: Inclusive
summary: INCLU'SIVE, adjective Inclosing; encircling. 1. Comprehended in the number or sum; as form Monday to Saturday inclusive that is, taking in both Monday and Saturday.

inlines.v: INCLU'SIVE, adjective Inclosing; encircling. 1. Comprehended in the number or sum; as form Monday to Saturday inclusive that is, taking in both Monday and Saturday.
